title: Conditional downstream calcium-response reconstruction after identified-neuron perturbation
scientific_question: Given a stimulated neuron's measured evoked calcium and a receiver's pre-stimulation trace, can a model predict that receiver's complete measured response in a held-out worm?
participant_inputs: For each experimentally observed source→receiver pair/trial, source calcium from−10to+30seconds, receiver calcium from−10to0, actual timestamps, verified neuron identities and stimulus timing/parameters. Include only information established independently of the withheld receiver response. Source post-stimulus input makes this retrospective conditional prediction, not forecasting before stimulation.
known_answer: Receiver fluorescence/time series from0to30seconds in the same trial, hidden in evaluator custody. This is an observed-response target, not a binary ground truth for direct synapses or mechanism.
complete_scope: All acquisitions and measured receiver/source pairs in the declared immutable release, including weak/nonresponding pairs and failed/self-response trials with explicit quality/coverage flags. This is a new release-level task, not whole-paper reproduction. The release's genotype/condition coverage must be reconciled against OSF; missing mutant or spontaneous cohorts cannot silently be claimed included.
protected_split: All recordings of one authenticated worm held together; session IDs/NWB subjects first joined to original acquisition and animal identities. If the same animal cannot be resolved, no between-animal result. Train-only pair kernels or mean responses exclude the held worm; neuron identities can recur across worms.
input_representation: All original time samples in each declared source/receiver window, with channel IDs, exact timestamps and explicit missingness. Each case is a genuine measured pair/trial, not a new benchmark. The complete case roster retains all receiver neurons; no significance selection or top-responsive-cell compression. Trace-only extraction must retain all declared measurements and metadata from the original release, with checksum/source-index joins; no fitted kernel/atlas substitute. If30s tails are unavailable, preserve explicit missing-time coverage and resolve one common supported horizon from development metadata before freeze.

scoring.primary: Receiver response MSE relative to training-only pair-mean predictor, aggregated over valid samples then trials/pairs within authenticated worm; compare per-worm paired error. Raw error and training-variance normalized error both reported.
scoring.secondary: Correlation and response-area error, with zero-variance cases explicitly handled; target variance or normalizing range from held response is evaluator-only and never agent-visible.
scoring.uncertainty: Worm-level paired intervals after identity verification, not pair/trial pseudo-replication.

comparators: Receiver pre-stimulus persistence/flat baseline, training-only source→receiver mean trajectory, and training-only linear convolution kernel fitted with regularization chosen on separate development worms. Author atlas kernels fitted using the full release are disallowed as clean held-out baselines; a declared exposed specialist is only an auxiliary condition.
negative_controls: Source traces reassigned across matched stimulations within animal/condition, preserving autocorrelation and missingness.
Target-neuron identity permutation, synchronization shifts and all-failure coverage audits.
leakage_controls: Published pooled kernels/response significance include prospective test animals.
Automated target assignment and ROI order can be wrong; independent acquisition→trace→identity alignment is a required gate.
Light artifact, adjacent-cell stimulation, source autoreponse and overall calcium state may explain gain.
Quality masks chosen from target effect size, target-side normalization and hidden spontaneous/mutant cohort mixing can leak.

resources: Full immutable DANDI release is4.07TB, not a laptop-scale download. A scientifically complete trace-only acquisition may be far smaller, but full trace-file/array manifest and exact total are UNESTABLISHED. paired_access_conditions.direct: No-tools inference on the complete canonical signal packet and target-free permitted context.
paired_access_conditions.numerical: Numerical tools on the identical packet. Frozen-program versus per-case adaptive tool use is separately logged within this task.
paired_access_conditions.specialist: Audited fixed feature extractor or train-only physiological model on identical information; trained model access is an assistance condition, not evidence of unaided understanding.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Same case IDs, inputs, units, masks, training/calibration exposure, protected answers, and transform support. Raw versus lossy derived signals are separately labelled input substrates; no equivalence assumed. Richer-input specialists are auxiliary.
paired_access_conditions.interpretation: Association, tool use, public exposure and physiological understanding remain separate. No model campaign is selected.

machine_output.predictions: Complete receiver calcium trace on authenticated0..30s poststimulus grid for every declared trial/source-receiver pair, with cases keyed by authentic worm/acquisition/genotype and pair.
machine_output.score_rows: Per-worm full-support MSE and difference from train-only pair-mean prediction; variance-normalized evaluation secondary, not a target-derived input. Every weak/nonresponse and unsupported pair retained.
machine_output.coverage: All acquisitions/pairs/conditions in declared release and complementary source scope;113metadata subjects are not assumed independent worms.

distinctness: Conditional response propagation from controlled neural stimulation, distinct from existing Flavell locomotor-turn decoding and history analyses.
stronger_claim_hold: Source input includes−10..+30s calcium while receiver context stops at0; this is retrospective conditional inference, not pre-stimulus forecasting or proof of direct synaptic connectivity.
